meta.title: PLC workspace
meta.description: Left-sidebar PLC engineering workspace for OMRON Sysmac Studio and Siemens TIA Portal, modelled on the AgentPLC idea of one workspace for the chat, the engineering tools and the project knowledge. It reads .smc2 projects offline (controller, tasks, POUs, ST sources and variable tables) and also creates new .smc2 projects: it takes an existing project as a template and writes the ST bodies, global variable table and project name you ask the agent to produce, with the result verified by opening it in Sysmac Studio. It converts .st sources into the IEC 61131-10 XML Sysmac Studio imports, and drives TIA Portal through the official Openness API to create .ap16/.ap18 projects, import SCL, compile and export blocks. The plugin adds the plc_env, plc_sysmac, plc_st and plc_tia agent tools. Open it from the PLC workspace entry above the session list, or just ask the agent. Python 3 is required for ST conversion; TIA automation requires the current Windows user in the "Siemens TIA Openness" group plus a fresh sign-in after joining. Reading and creating .smc2 projects are local file operations and never modify the template.
